I agree with the Router that the bottom sock's texture lacks the crisp fiber definition of a real macro photo, appearing slightly 'painted'. The severity is low (minor aesthetic flaw) but present.

The cuff of the top sock shows slight fusion where it curves. These are minor issues (severity ~1.5) that do not break the illusion but prevent a perfect artifact score.
